name: Plant.id (Kindwise)
tagline: Image-based plant identification and disease diagnosis API for apps
description: Plant.id by Kindwise is a computer-vision API that identifies plants, weeds, and diseases from photos. Developers send plant images and receive species suggestions with confidence scores, taxonomy, common names, and optional health/disease assessment. Widely used in gardening, farming, and agtech apps for field identification and crop health checks.

auth.details: API key via Api-Key header (or api_key query param in some endpoints); self-serve signup on web.plant.id

use_cases: identify a plant species from a photo
diagnose plant disease from leaf images
get plant taxonomy and common names
check plant health assessment from photos
